description: This file defines the AccountsViewDetail class, a specialized view for the account detail page in SugarCRM. It includes methods for displaying account information, handling address-related UI elements, and integrating with other modules such as Contacts and PDF templates.

classes.name: AccountsViewDetail
classes.description: A view class extending ViewDetail, customized for SugarCRM's account detail view, providing additional functionalities like address copying and popup handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the view by calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides the default display method to add custom rendering logic, address handling, and access control checks.

methods.name: generatePushCode
methods.description: Generates HTML code for a button that opens a contact popup to copy address data based on specified parameters.
